'''Jacqueline''' (Japanese: '''ジャクリーン''' ''Jacqueline'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[JN054|Sobble Spies a Stealthy Strategy!]]''.

She is an actress who starred alongside her {{p|Inteleon}} in a popular action movie called ''{{DL|Movies in the Pokémon world|Spy and Sidekick}}'', in which she portrays a spy. Due to the success of this movie, {{DL|Movies in the Pokémon world|Spy and Sniper 2|a sequel}} was made and slated to be directed by [[Kublock]]. While filming a scene for this movie, they were interrupted by {{TRT}}, who attempted to steal Inteleon. When they battled {{Ash}} and [[Goh]], Inteleon was able to send them blasting off with {{m|Snipe Shot}}. This caused [[Goh's Sobble]] to look up to Inteleon.

Jacqueline later appeared when Ash and Goh saved a crew member's {{p|Gothita}} from Team Rocket and praised Sobble on its work.

She reappeared in a flashback in ''[[JN062|Not Too Close for Comfort!]]''.
